sk = num(r.get("sacks_suffered") if r.get("sacks_suffered") not in (None, "") else r.get("sacks")) if att < 1: continue pid = r.get("player_id"); qname[pid] = r.get("player_display_name") or r.get("player_name") qdb[pid] += wgt * (att + sk);
